walkthroughs.body_html:
Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 2: Listening, Reading and Use of French.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: When does the past participle agree with avoir verbs?
options: Annually.
Always.
When the direct object comes BEFORE the verb (la pomme que j'ai mangée).
Never - avoir never causes agreement.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à mon ami.
Je vais chez mon ami.
Je vais à la maison de mon ami.
Always.
Currently/at the moment.
Je vais à mon ami.
Annually.
Actually (in reality).
